reason: The hypothesis synthesizes separate observations from the literature—heat-treatment-induced precipitate coarsening (P1, P11), elemental segregation (P17, P32), and protective oxide formation for corrosion (P3, P8) and oxidation (P2, P23)—into a single causal chain that links thermal treatment, microstructural evolution, surface chemistry change, and dual-property improvement. No single passage proposes this specific mechanism or the combined improvement of both corrosion and high-temperature oxidation through coarsening-driven segregation in Mg-containing lightweight HEAs.
